slides.title: Algorithm Basics
bullets: An algorithm is a step-by-step procedure
to solve a well-defined computational problem
Correctness ensures expected output for all inputs
Efficiency measures time and space resources
narration: An algorithm is a step-by-step procedure for solving tasks.
This defines a sequence of actions to reach a goal.

slides.title: Complexity Growth Rates
bullets: Big O notation describes upper bound performance
Comparing growth rates helps algorithm selection
Quadratic and exponential growth become prohibitive
narration: Common orders include constant, logarithmic, and linear growth.
These describe how performance scales with input.

slides.title: Sorting Algorithm Comparison
bullets: Selection sort finds minimum element each pass
Insertion sort builds sorted portion incrementally
Merge sort divides array and merges sorted halves
Quick sort partitions around a pivot element
narration: Quick sort partitions data around a chosen pivot element.
This divides the problem into smaller sub-problems.
